# Agricultural AI Assistant - Architecture & Design Document
## System Architecture Overview
``` ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ USER INTERFACE (Jetpack Compose) │ │ ┌──────────────┬──────────────┬──────────────────────┐ │ │ │ Home Screen │ Form Screen │ History Screen │ │ │ │ Splash │ Result Screen│ Analysis Selection │ │ │ └──────────────┴──────────────┴──────────────────────┘ │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ↓ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ VIEW MODELS (StateFlow) │ │ HomeViewModel, FormViewModel, ResultViewModel, │ │ HistoryViewModel, MainViewModel │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ↓ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ DOMAIN LAYER │ │ ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ │ │ Entities: AIResponse, AnalysisInput, Prompt, Topic │ │ │ │ Repositories: AIRepository (interface) │ │ │ │ UseCases: │ │ │ │ - GeneratePromptUseCase │ │ │ │ - SendPromptUseCase │ │ │ │ - SaveResultUseCase │ │ │ │ - GetResultsUseCase │ │ │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ↓ ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ DATA LAYER │ │ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ │ │ Remote │ │ Local │ │ Static │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ │ GeminiApi │ │ Room DAO │ │ Analysis │ │ │ │ (Retrofit) │ │ AppDatabase │ │ Types Data │ │ │ │ │ │ ResultEntity │ │ │ │ │ └──────────────┘ └──────────────┘ └──────────────┘ │ │ │ │ Repository Implementation: AIRepositoryImpl │ │ Mappers: GeminiMapper, ResponseMapper │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ```
## Data Flow Architecture
### Analysis Submission Flow
``` 1. User Interface ↓ 2. User selects analysis type (AnalysisSelectionScreen) ↓ 3. Fills dynamic form (DynamicFormScreen) ↓ 4. FormViewModel.submitForm() ├─ GeneratePromptUseCase generates prompt ├─ SendPromptUseCase sends to Gemini API ├─ Returns AIResponse with result ↓ 5. ResultScreen displays response ↓ 6. User clicks "Save" ├─ ResultViewModel.saveAnalysis() ├─ SaveResultUseCase persists to Room ↓ 7. Analysis saved to database ↓ 8. HistoryScreen retrieves via GetResultsUseCase ```
### Component Interaction Diagram
``` ┌──────────────────┐ │ MainActivity │─────────────────┐ │ (@HiltAndroidApp) │ └──────────────────┘ │ │ │ ├─→ MainViewModel │ │ ├─ isDarkMode (StateFlow) │ ├─ language (StateFlow) │ └─ Theme Management │ └─→ AppNavHost (Navigation) ├─ NavGraph ├─ NavController └─ 6 Screen Routes │ ├─ Splash ├─ Home (with BottomNav) │ ├─ Analyze Selection │ ├─ SelectionViewModel │ └─ AnalysisSelectionScreen │ ├─ Dynamic Form │ ├─ FormViewModel │ │ ├─ formData (StateFlow) │ │ ├─ isLoading (StateFlow) │ │ ├─ response (StateFlow) │ │ ├─ GeneratePromptUseCase │ │ └─ SendPromptUseCase │ └─ DynamicFormScreen │ ├─ Result │ ├─ ResultViewModel │ │ ├─ isSaving (StateFlow) │ │ ├─ saveSuccess (StateFlow) │ │ └─ SaveResultUseCase │ └─ ResultScreen │ └─ History ├─ HistoryViewModel │ ├─ results (StateFlow) │ └─ GetResultsUseCase └─ HistoryScreen ```
## Dependency Injection (Hilt) Architecture
``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ @HiltAndroidApp (MyApp) │ └─────────────────────────────────────────┘ │ ┌─────────┼─────────┬─────────┬────────────┐ │ │ │ │ │ ↓ ↓ ↓ ↓ ↓ ┌───────┐ ┌────────┐ ┌────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌─────────┐ │ App │ │Local │ │Network │ │Repository│ │UseCase │ │Module │ │Data │ │Module │ │Module │ │Module │ └───────┘ │Module │ └────────┘ └──────────┘ └─────────┘ └────────┘ │ ┌───────┴───────────────────────┐ │ │ ↓ ↓ Room Database Retrofit + Gson │ │ ├─ AppDatabase ├─ GeminiApi ├─ ResponseDao └─ Retrofit Instance ├─ ResultEntity └─ SettingsManager ```
## State Management Pattern (MVVM + StateFlow)
``` Composable Function │ ├─→ rememberCoroutineScope() │ ├─→ ViewModel.stateFlow.collectAsState() │ │ │ └─→ Recompose on state change │ └─→ Event Handler │ └─→ ViewModel.function() │ └─→ Update StateFlow │ └─→ Trigger recomposition ```
### Example: FormViewModel State Management
```kotlin // ViewModel @HiltViewModel class FormViewModel @Inject constructor( private val generatePrompt: GeneratePromptUseCase, private val sendPrompt: SendPromptUseCase ) : ViewModel() {
private val _formData = MutableStateFlow<Map<String, String>>(emptyMap()) val formData: StateFlow<Map<String, String>> = _formData
private val _isLoading = MutableStateFlow(false) val isLoading: StateFlow<Boolean> = _isLoading
fun submitForm(analysisType: AnalysisType) { viewModelScope.launch { try { _isLoading.value = true val input = AnalysisInput(analysisType, _formData.value) val prompt = generatePrompt(input) val result = sendPrompt(prompt) // Navigate on success } catch (e: Exception) { // Handle error } finally { _isLoading.value = false } } } }
// Composable @Composable fun DynamicFormScreen( viewModel: FormViewModel = hiltViewModel() ) { val formData by viewModel.formData.collectAsState() val isLoading by viewModel.isLoading.collectAsState()
// UI updates when states change } ```
## Database Schema
### ResultEntity Table
```sql CREATE TABLE results ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, analysisType TEXT NOT NULL, inputData TEXT NOT NULL, -- JSON string aiResponse TEXT NOT NULL, timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT DEFAULT '' ); ```
### Room DAO Pattern
```kotlin @Dao interface ResponseDao { @Insert suspend fun insertResult(result: ResultEntity)
@Query("SELECT * FROM results ORDER BY timestamp DESC") fun getAllResults(): Flow<List<ResultEntity>>
@Delete suspend fun deleteResult(result: ResultEntity)
@Query("SELECT * FROM results WHERE analysisType = :type LIMIT 1") suspend fun getResultByAnalysisType(type: String): ResultEntity? } ```
## Navigation Architecture
### Route Structure
``` Sealed Class: ScreensRoute ├── Splash: "splash_screen" ├── Home: "home_screen" ├── Analyze: "analyze_screen" ├── Form: "form_screen/{analysisType}" │ └── Argument: analysisType (String) ├── Loading: "loading_screen" ├── Result: "result_screen" │ └── SavedState: response, analysisType └── History: "history_screen" ```
### Navigation Graph Flow
``` NavHost(navController, startDestination = Splash) ├── Splash → Home (popUpTo Splash) ├── Home → {Analyze OR History} ├── Analyze → Form ├── Form → Result (via SavedState) ├── Result → Home └── History → (view only) ```
## API Integration Architecture
### Gemini API Request/Response
``` Request Flow: User Input ↓ FormViewModel ↓ GeneratePromptUseCase ↓ Prompt String ↓ SendPromptUseCase ↓ AIRepositoryImpl.sendAIRequest() ↓ GeminiRequestDto Creation ↓ Retrofit Call: GeminiApi.generateContent() ↓ GeminiResponseDto Received ↓ Extract Text via extractText() ↓ AIResponse Created ↓ ViewModels receive response ↓ UI Updates ```
### API Data Models
``` GeminiRequestDto ├── contents: List<Content> └── Content └── parts: List<Part> └── Part └── text: String
GeminiResponseDto ├── candidates: List<Candidate> └── Candidate └── content: ContentResponse └── ContentResponse └── parts: List<PartResponse> └── PartResponse └── text: String ```
## Clean Architecture Layer Separation
### Presentation Layer - **Responsibility**: Display UI, handle user interactions - **Technologies**: Jetpack Compose, ViewModels, StateFlow - **Dependencies**: Domain Layer only - **Classes**: Screens, ViewModels, UI Components
### Domain Layer - **Responsibility**: Business logic, orchestration - **Technologies**: Kotlin, Coroutines - **Dependencies**: None (frameworks agnostic) - **Classes**: Use Cases, Entities, Repository Interfaces
### Data Layer - **Responsibility**: Data access, persistence - **Technologies**: Room, Retrofit, Gson - **Dependencies**: Domain Layer (via Repository Interface) - **Classes**: DAOs, APIs, Repositories, Mappers, DTOs
## Localization Architecture
### Multi-Language Support
``` User Selects Language ↓ MainViewModel.setLanguage(lang) ↓ SettingsManager.setLanguage(lang) ↓ Saved to DataStore ↓ MainActivity loads language from DataStore ↓ Context locale updated ↓ Compose automatically uses correct strings.xml ```
### String Resource Organization
``` res/ ├── values/ │ └── strings.xml (English) │ ├── app_name │ ├── analysis_irrigation │ ├── field_crop │ └── ... (50+ strings) │ └── values-ar/ └── strings.xml (Arabic) ├── app_name ├── analysis_irrigation ├── field_crop └── ... (same keys, Arabic values) ```
## Error Handling Architecture
``` try-catch in UseCase/Repository ↓ Flow error through Result sealed class OR Emit error state in ViewModel ↓ UI collects error state ↓ Display user-friendly error message ↓ Option to retry or go back ```
## Performance Optimizations
### Memory Efficiency - LazyColumn for long lists - Proper disposal of StateFlows in viewModelScope - Database queries optimized with Room indices
### Network Efficiency - Single Retrofit instance (Singleton via Hilt) - Request/Response DTOs minimize data transfer - Coroutines avoid blocking main thread
### UI Responsiveness - All database/network operations on IO dispatcher - StateFlow recomposition optimization - Compose lazy loading
## Testing Architecture
### Unit Testing Structure
``` test/ ├── domain/ │ ├── usecase/ │ │ ├── GeneratePromptUseCaseTest │ │ └── SaveResultUseCaseTest │ └── repository/ │ └── AIRepositoryTest │ ├── data/ │ ├── mapper/ │ │ └── ResponseMapperTest │ └── local/ │ └── ResultEntityMapperTest │ └── presentation/ └── viewmodel/ ├── FormViewModelTest └── HistoryViewModelTest ```
### Testing Patterns
```kotlin // Unit Test Example @RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class) class FormViewModelTest {
@get:Rule val instantExecutorRule = InstantTaskExecutorRule()
private val mockRepository = mock<AIRepository>() private val generatePrompt = GeneratePromptUseCase() private val sendPrompt = SendPromptUseCase(mockRepository)
private lateinit var viewModel: FormViewModel
@Before fun setup() { viewModel = FormViewModel(generatePrompt, sendPrompt) }
@Test fun testSubmitForm() = runBlocking { // Arrange val testInput = AnalysisInput(AnalysisType.IRRIGATION, mapOf())
// Act viewModel.submitForm(AnalysisType.IRRIGATION)
// Assert assertEquals(true, viewModel.isLoading.value) } } ```
## Security Architecture
### API Key Management
``` BuildConfig (Not Committed) ↓ local.properties (Git Ignored) ↓ Loaded at Build Time ↓ Secure: Never in Source Code ```
### Data Storage
``` User Preferences ↓ DataStore (Encrypted at rest) ↓ Secure: Only on device
Analysis Results ↓ Room Database (Encrypted via SQLCipher optional) ↓ Secure: Application private directory ```
## Scalability Considerations
### Adding New Analysis Types
1. Add to `AnalysisType` enum 2. Add fields to `StaticDataProvider` 3. Add prompt template to `StaticDataProvider` 4. Automatic form generation from fields
### Adding New Screens
1. Create Screen composable 2. Create ViewModel (with Hilt @HiltViewModel) 3. Add route to `ScreensRoute` 4. Add composable to `NavGraph` 5. Wire navigation in existing screens
### Adding New API Endpoints
1. Add method to `GeminiApi` interface 2. Create new DTO models in `dtomodel/` 3. Extend `AIRepository` interface 4. Implement in `AIRepositoryImpl` 5. Create UseCase for business logic
---
**This architecture ensures clean, maintainable, and scalable code following industry best practices.**
